scope: One diagnostic next-wave GPU fidelity check of a reconstructed reference; original128wave nonconvergence remains failed. No physical or full solver qualification.
protocol: Single next-wave fidelity witness. Run original contact-metric convergence candidate unchanged through all eight phases and original128cap/reports, then exactly one diagnostic final relaxation wave after reporting. No change to convergence acceptance or failure; no trajectory qualification. Original input/coefficients/bounds/order retained. Require exact initial getters, unchanged body poses and original eight reported iteration/residual records (proving witness does not alter preceding phases); all finite caches/velocities, original identity/order. Compare all734actual caches and258body velocity components against float64 reconstructed next wave. Predeclared model-fidelity screen maximum component |predicted-actual|/(1+max(|predicted|,|actual|)) <=2e-5, allowing float32 arithmetic and reconstructed pose rounding; this does not replace1e-8reference or1e-5convergence tests. Preserve failures and inspect first/worst block on mismatch; no tolerance retry. Shader source restored after build and normal archive rebuilt after probe.

result.scope: Single diagnostic extra wave after unchanged failed128wave report, compared with endpoint reconstruction. No physical/convergence qualification.

localization.scope: Local solves evaluated with preceding actual GPU cache increments mapped through reconstructed Jacobians; dependent on affine velocity fidelity.

 actual_impulses[b['sl']]=m.v(value) if isinstance(value,list) else m.f(value)

No physical/convergence qualification.')

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,numpy as np
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parent/'rain-coupled-reference'))
import model as m
from wave import ops,solve_pair
state=np.load(p/'comparison.npz');actual=state['actual_impulses'];actualv=state['actual_velocity'];velocity=m.vcap.copy();x=m.old.copy();rows=[]
rel=lambda a,b:abs(a-b)/(1+np.maximum(abs(a),abs(b)))
for index,b in enumerate(ops):
 ii=b['indices'];before=x[ii].copy();grad=b['J']@velocity+b['bias']+b['G']@before;K=b['K']+b['G'];new=before-b['inverse']@grad
 if b['domain']=='positive':new=np.maximum(new,0)
 elif b['domain']=='positive_pair':new=solve_pair(K,grad-K@before)
 elif b['domain']=='box':new=np.clip(new,-m.radius(b,x),m.radius(b,x))
 elif b['domain']=='ball':new=m.metric_project(K,grad-K@before,m.radius(b,x))
 rows.append(dict(order=index,label=b['label'],relative_error=float(max(rel(new,actual[ii]))),predicted=new.tolist(),actual=actual[ii].tolist(),before=before.tolist()))
 velocity+=b['B']@(actual[ii]-before);x[ii]=actual[ii]
result=dict(scope='Local solves evaluated with preceding actual GPU cache increments mapped through reconstructed Jacobians; dependent on affine velocity fidelity.',maximum_affine_velocity_error=float(max(rel(velocity,actualv))),worst_affine_body=int(np.argmax(rel(velocity,actualv))//6+1),maximum_local_cache_error=max(a['relative_error'] for a in rows),first_failing_row=next((a for a in rows if a['relative_error']>2e-5),None),ranked=sorted(rows,key=lambda a:a['relative_error'],reverse=True),ordered=rows)
(p/'localization.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['ranked','ordered']},indent=2));print(json.dumps(result['ranked'][:8],indent=2))
